sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-handoff-audit/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks!A16:D16 and Internal Quality Checks!A16:D16 (row 15; no cell comments)
evidence: Row 15 and its internal annotation require a pinned, preinstalled, asset-staging agent image. Frozen task/environment/Dockerfile:1-12 uses the template versioned base node:22-bookworm-slim, NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, and build-time global express@5.1.0 plus better-sqlite3@12.4.1, matching integration.md:3-5 and solution/app/package.json. Lines 14-23 copy only instructions/assets, make them readable, and create an otherwise empty git-initialized /app with .gitkeep; lines 25-26 perform no runtime install. The Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 0a75419e9598ded9317b26bbf0d2b12de0b9b11185fb4c9fed1ca7f3e52467d1). Actual local/agent-build.log shows cached dependency layers, executed staging/git steps, and successful image 6f870f89caf1f289e70732cbc1d5a430722288d7902f0dc56f58728da69b0e84. The network-disabled Node image inspection in bind-inputs.py and input-binding.json shows the two instruction files and seed have exactly the frozen source hashes. Independently recomputed index hashes match: agent-build.log 32a042b0b6cfe263fe568bca4c62734a7c31ea6d4b3ce104a7151de2232745c9; input-binding.json b0d475a9cf64ed2e01b6a01999e8baa1302e27f6f74b9b95faf00d5490312fbb; input-binding.log a76861686498c07ceaa90d866a87c5ac01d248b7dbd62fe343c4f1ae1158e1a8; bind-inputs.py 5a8ccedbd9e006efa7dcf34759bb4bd329241db7974d67f977a6464dc7b32451. Counterexample analysis: a missing global package/NODE_PATH or uncopied seed could break a conforming app, but those defects are excluded by the declared build and inspected staged bytes; a static or otherwise broken submission can still execute in this image, which is appropriately judged by other rows. A conforming app with a different internal layout can use the same installed packages without runtime installation. This is cached image-build/staging evidence, not a cold-build timing, configured judge, or portal result.
